about: Stacked excess-surface-density profiles of the GAMA G3C v10 groups in the KiDS-1000 shear, with the single-mass halo fit and the stellar masses of each bin. Units: R in Mpc (physical), esd in Msun/pc^2, cov in (Msun/pc^2)^2, masses in Msun. group_models.py describes the measurement and the fields.
